title: PRD-24 synthetic risk input syntax

organizationRef.description: required; authorized group buyer context. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

groupTypeCode.description: required; approved vehicle/asset/person schedule type. Sensitivity: internal. Error: GROUP_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

scheduleBatchRef.description: required; approved row identities/schema/version. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: SCHEDULE_NOT_APPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

underlyingProductId.description: required per row/group; approved PRD family; no recursive PRD-24. Sensitivity: internal. Error: UNDERLYING_PRODUCT_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

effectiveDate.description: required per change; contract timezone and effective-window validation. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: GROUP_EFFECTIVE_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

allocationCode.description: required for billing; branch/cost-center mapping <= 60. Sensitivity: financial. Error: ALLOCATION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

certificateMode.description: required; master-only or individual if contract permits. Sensitivity: internal. Error: CERTIFICATE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

proposalVersion.description: required at commitment; positive approved master/schedule revision. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: GROUP_APPROVAL_STALE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
